name: Quiz
summary: A short, marked check of knowledge: multiple choice, labelling, matching and short answers.

name: Practice exam
summary: An exam section or past-paper questions done under timed conditions.

name: Problem set
summary: A set of problems solved with full working, handed in and marked.

name: Short written response
summary: A paragraph or short answer to a question or stimulus, using a directive verb such as explain, compare or justify.

name: Draft submission
summary: A draft of the summative task, or one section of it, handed in for feedback before the final is due.

name: Annotation task
summary: A text, source, image, diagram or work sample annotated to explain its features and what they show.

name: Practice composition
summary: A short original piece written or composed to practise a form before the real task.

name: Research task
summary: A set research question answered and handed in, with sources recorded.

name: Investigation write-up
summary: A first-hand test, experiment or fieldwork activity written up as aim, method, results and conclusion.

name: Practical task
summary: A skill or technique performed or produced to a set standard and marked against criteria.

name: Mini project
summary: A small task that uses the skills and steps the larger summative project needs.

name: Rehearsal showing
summary: A work-in-progress performance, piece or routine shown for marked feedback.

name: Portfolio section
summary: One section of a portfolio, folio or journal handed in by a set date.

name: Practice presentation
summary: A short presentation of work or findings, alone or in a group, marked with written feedback.

name: Poster or visual summary
summary: Information presented visually on one page for a set purpose and audience.

name: Progress interview
summary: A short one-to-one conversation where the student explains their work, with the teacher's written notes as feedback.

name: Project
summary: A made or produced piece of work with supporting documentation, developed over a unit.

name: Major work
summary: A substantial, sustained piece of individual work, usually in Stage 6.

name: Negotiated project
summary: A project where the student proposes the question, brief or focus, with teacher approval.

name: Group project
summary: A project completed in a team, with an individually assessed part.

name: Performance or exhibition
summary: Resolved work presented live or displayed for an audience.

name: Creative composition
summary: An original piece composed for a purpose and audience, usually with a reflection or rationale.

name: Portfolio
summary: A collection of work gathered over time, assessed as its own task.

name: Process journal
summary: A dated record of the work as it develops: decisions, problems and changes.

name: Proposal or plan
summary: A written and visual plan presented before the main work begins.

name: Reflection or evaluation
summary: A written judgement of the finished work and the process, against the criteria or aims.

name: Research report
summary: An inquiry using sources, written up with findings and a conclusion.

name: Practical investigation report
summary: A first-hand test or experiment written up with method, results and conclusion.

name: Case study
summary: A structured study of one example: a person, organisation, place, event, product or innovation.

name: Source or stimulus analysis
summary: A structured analysis of a source, text, artwork, product or data set, seen or unseen.

name: Extended response
summary: An essay-length response to a question, using evidence and examples.

name: Investigation or assignment
summary: An open task where students apply what they know to a problem or question, completed over time rather than under exam conditions.

name: Oral presentation
summary: A spoken presentation of work or findings to an audience.

name: Multimodal presentation
summary: A presentation combining spoken, visual and digital elements, live or recorded.

name: Pitch
summary: An idea, concept or finished piece presented and justified to a client or panel.

name: Interview, conversation or viva voce
summary: A structured interview in which the student explains and defends their work.

name: Video or media piece
summary: A recorded piece made for an audience: to instruct, inform or promote.

name: Poster or visual display
summary: Findings or ideas presented visually for an audience, often explained in person.

name: Discussion or seminar
summary: An assessed discussion in which each student contributes, responds to others and builds the argument.

name: Topic test
summary: A test on one topic, held in a normal lesson.

name: Examination
summary: A formal timed paper held in an exam block.

name: In-class written task
summary: A written response completed in a lesson under supervised conditions.

name: Practical test
summary: Practical skills shown under observed, timed conditions.

name: Listening or aural task
summary: A task in which students respond to spoken or recorded material.

name: Competency assessment
summary: A task judged as competent or not yet competent against a set standard, used in VET courses.
